entities.summary: Esther Martinez, also known as Estefanita Martinez, was an American linguist and storyteller for the Tewa people of New Mexico. Martinez was given the Tewa name P’oe Tsą́wą̈́ and was also known by various affectionate names, including "Ko'oe Esther" and "Aunt Esther".
